title: Prove sharp mutable-source connectivity restoration bound
body:
## Result

Closes the explicit source-XOR optimality handoff in Arham Tahir's merged PR #1898 / discussion #1579. In the generic common-B mutable-source connector, if the complete source-XOR interaction graph has k components, every restored finite word obeys

- Q >= n+k;
- X >= 2(n-k);
- therefore 2Q+X >= 4n and the sharp X count at minimum Q=n+1 is 2(n-1).

The credited PR1898 construction attains the new lower bound; its construction and readout theorem are not claimed as new. The package also gives the sharp projected Q/X frontier, with unrestricted readouts, and a sufficient global unequal-price optimality cone. For n=5, complete prices b >= 34a+2x make 6b+96a+8x the global tariff minimum over all finite words. The fully expanded eight-factor abstract fixture has (b,a,x)=(86,2,2), exact optimum 724, and every Q>=7 competitor costs at least 738.

The key new proof is a source-matrix support-component potential. Adding one auxiliary edge between the XOR's row vertices makes the support partition invariant across the gate. Thus each historical component merge decreases the current component count by one, and final source restoration requires equally many increases. This covers arbitrary redundant/cancelling gates; a literal control never mixes all sources simultaneously. The query bound follows from full rank and zero-sum dependence separately in every historical component.

## Evidence and reproduction

Only `research/mutable-source-connectivity-bound/` is added. Complete source pins, independently drawn SELECTION, TASK, written proof, deterministic receipts and explicit VERIFY hook are included.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/mutable-source-connectivity-bound/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/mutable-source-connectivity-bound
```

Actually passed on CPython3.12.12/macOS arm64:

- 242,940 single-gate GL1..4 transitions, with independent row-intersection oracle;
- bounded closed-source-word census and 66 integer-partition witnesses for n=1..8;
- complete free-linear dirty-state/noncommuting forward and inverse expansion;
- 288 independently implemented dense forward/inverse cases, 40 dirty rows;
- 12 primary and five independent semantic controls, including removal of an actual private uncompute leaf;
- five focused CLI/source/receipt/relocation/regeneration tests;
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

An initial tuple/list receipt-comparison failure was corrected by canonical whole-JSON comparison; no proof-relevant receipt field is skipped. The parent separately reviewed the proof and replayed the final package before publication.

## Scope and attribution

This is a written all-n proof with finite machine evidence, not formal-kernel acceptance. The price cone is sufficient, not the complete unequal-price classification. Abstract unit prices do not establish favorable tape costs, a selected-supplier caller, a paid moment improvement, physical runtime gain, or new kappa. All selected/frozen inputs remain unchanged; no selected cold replay or hosted-CI success is claimed.

Credit Arham Tahir (PR1340, PR1370, PR1898), TennisBowling (PR1524), Ross Richardson (PR943/934), and the inherited shhxera/CubeJerry / Chafik Boukhalfa lineage. Exact heads are pinned; targeted live checks confirm all five direct predecessors merged at those heads. Cached overlap covered329openPRs and692discussions with full pagination and explicit freshness warnings; a targeted live all-state source-XOR search found34PRs and no same missing-lemma closure. Search is not a novelty certificate.

Independent seed `40c024ae825b6e48dce27fd8e1257c7b`, recursive-interfaces / connector-alphabet-change. Exact base `e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a`. Scoped claim: #research-claim-and-completion-record
